back.PUBLISHED: Publication withdrawn: the grade is back to graded

body.PUBLISHED: The grade stops being published and the student will not see it until it is published again. No grade is deleted.
body.IN_REVIEW: The exam moves to pending review so you can change the grades of the requested exercises. Resolving the requests closes it and the student sees the result.
body.FINALIZED: The exam goes back to pending review so it can be graded again. No grade is deleted.

save.hint: Saves scores, rubric, comments, audio and annotations for this exam. {{done}}/{{total}} exercises graded.
save.readyHint: Every exercise has a score. Press Save and the exam will be marked as graded.
save.notMarked: The exam stays pending: it will be marked as graded when saved with every exercise scored.
save.noMore: No more exams left to grade.
save.failed: Not everything could be saved. Check the red notices and press Save again.
save.reviewCompleted: Review resolved. The updated grade is available to the student.
save.reviewFailed: Grades were saved, but the review could not be completed. Retry Save; publication has not been confirmed.

annotations.loadError: Annotations could not be loaded. Retry before editing.
annotations.saveError: Changes could not be saved. They remain on screen; retry saving.
annotations.ownLayer: Undo and clear affect only your current layer.
annotations.author: Teacher

side.noProblems: This model has no problems yet. Add them in the exam setup to start grading.
side.commentHint: Saved automatically. The student sees it during review.
side.unknownGrades: This exam was already graded from another session. The API can't return per-problem grades, so re-grading may conflict.

problem.conflict: Another session changed this grade: the saved value is shown. Check it and save again.

ocr.padHint: Write here with a pen or the mouse
ocr.gradeUnreadable: No number was recognised. Try writing it larger.
ocr.commentAdded: Text added to the comment ({{pct}} % confidence). Check it before publishing.

errors.NOT_AUTHOR: Only the annotation author (or a manager) can run recognition on it.
errors.NO_PROBLEM_ASSOCIATED: A handwritten grade must be linked to a problem.
errors.NO_CONTENT: The annotation has no strokes to recognise.
errors.NOT_STYLUS: Only freehand annotations can be recognised.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This annotation type does not support recognition.
errors.INVALID_STYLUS_PAYLOAD: The strokes have an invalid format.
errors.EMPTY_STYLUS_PAYLOAD: There is no ink to recognize.
errors.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Check the value before using it.
errors.SCORE_EXCEEDS_MAX: The score exceeds the problem maximum.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The score has changed. Reload it before saving.
errors.REFRESH_FAILED: The score was saved but could not be reloaded. Refresh before continuing.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The annotation is no longer available.
errors.COURSE_ARCHIVED: Grades in an archived course cannot be changed.

ocr.refreshFailed: The score was saved but could not be reloaded. Refresh before continuing.

errors.MIC_DENIED: Could not access the microphone. You can upload an audio file.
errors.AUDIO_FORMAT_UNREADABLE: The audio could not be read.
errors.AUDIO_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported audio format (webm, ogg, mp3, m4a or wav).
errors.AUDIO_DURATION_EXCEEDED: The audio exceeds the organisation's maximum duration.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission for this audio.
errors.UNKNOWN: The audio could not be saved. Try again.
